target: Let E be a real normed space and f:E to EReal be SourceProper: no bottom value anywhere and a finite value somewhere. Let V be the literal convex feasible set, V contained in effectiveDomain f, and lambda>=0. Assume the Definition4.1 strong interpolation inequality with penalty lambda/2 for every x,y in V and 0<a<1. Supply p in V and one continuous real linear functional g such that f(p)+g(z-p)<=f(z) for every z in V. For every q in V, f(p)+g(q-p)+(lambda/2)||q-p||^2<=f(q). Every displayed endpoint is finite by properness plus domain inclusion; toReal uses these genuine finite values. g may be zero and lambda may be zero. Printed Lemma4.2 (printed34-35/PDF46-47) is an iff with V subset dom(partial f). This theorem is explicitly its generalized forward implication at one supplied support at p, localized to literal V; support existence at other V points is dropped. The finite-dimensional vector/dot-product interface is generalized to a continuous real dual functional on an arbitrary normed space. Vector representation, indicator restriction/extension and transport to the source chosen arbitrary norm remain unfinished. No inner-product norm on E is imposed. Locally compiled and independently BODY/source-reviewed generalized forward dependency; imported production audit passed. Reader/native integration is proposed, with combined gates and final leaf acceptance pending.
